summary: Iteration-7 tested the admin EIBIL insight suite (Employees list, Employee 360, Employer 360, admin Applications CRUD, generic from/to + CSV export). Added TestAdminInsights (14 tests) and TestAdminResourceDateAndExport (2 tests) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all 16 PASS (`pytest -n 0`). Frontend verified via Playwright as admin@eibil.in + devOtp: dashboard stat cards exist and navigate; funnel items navigate to /admin/applications?status=; /admin/employees exposes all requested testIds (filter-band/panVerified/openToWork/scoreMin/scoreMax, sort, from, to, export, search); CSV download fires (`employees-2026-10-07.csv`); row click opens Employee 360 at /admin/employees/:id with score gauge, trend, 4 stat cards, profile, and all 9 tabs (applications/score/employment/evaluations/viewers/offers/exits/disputes/flags); employee-360-export downloads `employee-360-applications-2026-10-07.csv`; app-status-<id> inline select changes application status (applied → shortlisted, backend audit log written); employee-adjust-score modal opens and Save works; employee-edit-record drawer opens showing EmployeeProfile fields. Employer 360 (via employer-360-<id> button) renders all 8 tabs (jobs/applicants/roster/evaluations/reports/payments/credits/team), applicantCount per job, and employer-360-export CSV works. On the other admin lists (users/employers/fraud/verification/jobs) the generic -from/-to/-export testIds all render. One real regression spotted: the login page LEFT HERO still contains the string 'Consent-first reports. You control who sees what.' — the review request explicitly stated this copy should no longer say 'consent-first'. Backend date range (from=2030-01-01) correctly returns total 0 on /admin/employees, /admin/applications and all tested paginated admin lists; export=1 raises meta.limit to 5000 as spec'd.

ui_bugs.issue: Still displays 'Consent-first reports. You control who sees what.' — spec requires this consent-first wording to be removed.

action_items: Remove the 'Consent-first reports. You control who sees what.' line from the Login/public auth hero (should match the new copy without the word 'consent-first').
Nice-to-have: ensure 'band' field is always present (null-safe) in /admin/employees rows for consistent client parsing (currently omitted when the employee has no score).
critical_code_review_comments: adminInsightService.listEmployees: returns `band: p.band` which collapses to undefined/absent key for unscored employees. Prefer always-serialised `band: p.band ?? null` so clients can rely on key presence for empty-state rendering/CSV columns.

People.jsx AdminVerification (line 91) uses `import.meta.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` for inline document links. In this Vite build the var is exposed as `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` via vite config (works today), but mixing Vite's `import.meta.env` with legacy CRA naming is fragile — standardise on one.

routes/admin/index.js registers both `router.get('/applications', ..., insight.applications)` (line 46) and `router.get('/applications', ..., oversight.applications)` (line 124). Express will serve the first registration; the second line is dead code and should be removed to avoid confusion.
adminInsightService.setApplicationStatus hard-codes `[Admin]` prefix and pushes to app.notes without checking schema length limits — fine for now, worth guarding against huge notes arrays over time.

withDateRange in utils/pagination.js parses `from=YYYY-MM-DD` with raw `new Date(from)` (UTC midnight) but `to` ends at 23:59:59.999Z — asymmetric. Consider also snapping `from` to start-of-day for consistency and to avoid off-by-one issues when the admin lives in IST (UTC+5:30).

rca of the issue: Login copy regression — the hero bullet in the left panel of /login still reads 'Consent-first reports. You control who sees what.'. The review request lists this exact copy change as part of the regression bar, meaning the copy was supposed to be rewritten/removed. The string lives in the public auth layout (left hero column). Fix = replace or delete that bullet in the auth layout component used by Login.jsx.
